text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building and maintaining production web applications. While my background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and HTML/CSS, the core of my work has always been the same: keep systems reliable, accurate, and resilient under pressure.

For example, I built a white-label class booking app for Pulsebox Studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. Each studio got its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships, and we onboarded 64 studios in 6 months. I also rebuilt the Home goods storefront for Juniper & Ash Home into a headless storefront with a CMS the marketing team could manage themselves, and the largest contentful paint improved from 4.1s to 1.3s.

I understand that this role is different from my usual stack, but the work you need is about vigilance, careful judgment, fast correction, and clear communication under hostile conditions. I’m comfortable working methodically, checking details, and making sure changes stay aligned with the rules of the system I’m working in. For a Wikipedia page under attack, that means monitoring edits closely, reverting malicious changes promptly, and helping preserve accuracy and neutrality while staying professional.

I’m also used to collaborating with stakeholders and working within constraints, which translates well to discussion pages and communication with admins or WikiProjects. I approach problems calmly, document my decisions, and focus on maintaining trust in the content rather than escalating conflict.

If you’re looking for someone steady, detail-oriented, and responsive, I’d be glad to help protect and maintain the page.
